SCTP::rto_max
Description
This command returns the maximum value of SCTP retranmission timeout.
Can specify the value on clientside or serverside.
Syntax
SCTP
::
rto_max
[
clientside
|
serverside
]
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
log
local0.info
"SCTP retransmission timeout maximum value is [SCTP::rto_max]"
}
when
SERVER_CONNECTED
{
log
local0.info
"SCTP retransmission timeout maximum value is [SCTP::rto_max]"
}
